semantics.subject_rule: Requester/subject identity and exact resource scope are explicit.
semantics.data_rule: Audit records identify data/resource scope without copying denied/protected content by default.
semantics.denial_rule: Denied access remains auditable without leaking denied values.
semantics.query_rule: Queries may record exact query identity/hash/profile rather than full sensitive result payload.
semantics.authority_rule: Audit visibility does not grant access to source data.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
